issues.where: upper right limb, aurora (crops C, L, M of image-02/03)
issues.what: the aurora is a band of green flame-shaped streaks with a red smear behind it. It looks pasted on and sits partly off the planet in empty space instead of hugging the atmosphere above the night side. Its streaks repeat in even, comb-like spacing
issues.fix: draw the aurora as soft, translucent curtains that follow the curve of the planet just inside the limb on the night side. Vary the spacing and brightness and blend it into the atmosphere glow

issues.where: upper right limb, aurora (crops C, I, L of image-06/07)
issues.what: the same pasted-on green comb of streaks, now sitting on the sunlit limb with a hard, saturated edge and a red haze around it. Aurora should not be visible against a lit limb
issues.fix: move the aurora to the dark side, cut its saturation and give it a soft falloff

issues.where: right half of the globe, night side (crops E, H, I, Q, R, V)
issues.what: there is no real terminator. The globe just darkens toward the right, and the dark limb meets the sky in a hard, cutout-looking edge with almost no atmosphere glow. Small green blobs float on the dark surface over South America and the Atlantic
issues.fix: render a soft terminator line with a twilight band, keep a thin atmosphere rim around the night limb, and remove the stray green spots

issues.where: right and lower right limb (crops E, G, H, Q, U)
issues.what: the dark limb is a crisp disc edge on the Milky Way with no glow, so the planet looks like a flat cutout laid over the backdrop
issues.fix: add a faint atmospheric halo along the night limb and soften the edge against the sky

issues.where: Pacific off Mexico, hurricane (crops F, P); image-05 crops F, O
issues.what: the hurricane is an overly perfect, high-contrast spiral that looks stamped onto softer, airbrushed cloud fields. The cloud swirls on the Atlantic side repeat similar curl shapes
issues.fix: match the storm's contrast and detail to the clouds around it, and vary the shapes of the swirls

issues.where: eastern Brazil and Andes, city lights (crops H, Q); image-05 crops E, P, U
issues.what: orange city lights glow on ground that is still partly lit, and they sit evenly along coastlines like a sprinkled texture
issues.fix: show city lights only past the terminator and fade them in across the twilight band

issues.where: land surfaces, North America and Amazon (crops A, K, I)
issues.what: the terrain is oversaturated and airbrushed, with a plastic, illustrated look. The shallow-water cyan in the Caribbean and Bahamas is uniformly neon
issues.fix: lower saturation, add finer natural texture variation, and tone down the shallow-water cyan

issues.where: dark sky, bottom left and lower edge (crops O, T, W of image-03/04; S, V of image-08)
issues.what: a faint blocky, grid-like compression pattern is visible in the near-black sky at native size
issues.fix: add fine dither or noise to the dark sky gradient and export with less compression

issues.where: moon, upper right (crop M); image-05 crop L
issues.what: the moon is a small, soft, low-detail disc. Its phase and lighting do not match the planet's sun direction
issues.fix: light the moon from the same side as the planet and sharpen its surface detail

issues.where: right limb at the aurora (image-14.png crops G and I, image-15.png crop Q)
issues.what: the blue atmospheric rim stops abruptly where the aurora begins, leaving a hard dark disc edge with airbrushed radial aurora streaks pasted behind it
issues.fix: render the aurora volumetrically inside a continuous upper-atmosphere scattering shell rather than compositing streaks behind a hard planet mask

issues.where: lower-right Milky Way sky (image-14.png crops E and H, image-16.png crops U, V and W)
issues.what: stars across the Milky Way band are large, blurry, out-of-focus blobs and smeared noise clusters that clash with the crisp 1-2 pixel stars on the left
issues.fix: replace the low-resolution blurred Milky Way patch with native-resolution point-source stars over clean galactic dust

issues.where: Greenland, western-limb clouds, and night-side South America (image-14.png crops A, C and F, image-15.png crop P)
issues.what: Greenland is a flat chalky airbrushed patch, western-limb clouds stretch along the sphere edge, night-side South America has blotchy dark tones, and stray yellow city-light blobs float in the Atlantic off Brazil
issues.fix: use higher-resolution albedo, cloud, and coastline-masked city-light maps with crisp polar detail and smooth shadow-side gradation

issues.where: sunlit left and upper-right limb and dark lower-left limb (image-14.png crop A, image-15.png crops L and P)
issues.what: a thin bright cyan-white outline traces the globe edge inside the atmosphere and faint concentric halo steps appear in the outer glow
issues.fix: soften the inner limb scattering transition and dither the outer atmospheric falloff at higher bit depth

issues.where: sun-glint ocean and right-side islands and reefs (image-10.png crops A, G and I, image-11.png crops P, Q and R)
issues.what: sun-glint wave ripples are embossed at an overscaled pitch for orbital altitude, island coastlines and turquoise reefs look softly painterly at native size, and a faint magenta smudge sits under a cloud shadow in crop Q
issues.fix: reduce sea-surface wave scale to fine orbital micro-glint, sharpen coastal terrain and reef boundaries, and remove the chromatic smudge under the cloud shadow

issues.where: atmospheric limb and top-center sky flare (image-10.png crops B and C, image-11.png crops J, K and L)
issues.what: a dark blue trough stripe separates the bright lower horizon from the upper blue haze along the entire limb, and the top-center flare adds speckled noise and slight banding in the dark sky
issues.fix: blend the multi-band atmospheric limb falloff more smoothly and dither the top-center lens flare gradient
